architectures.description: List of supported architectures; native + foreign (e.g. 'i386' on amd64).

ignore_hold.description: Whether packages on hold are ignored during dependency resolution.

clean_installed.description: Whether installed packages are exempt from apt-get clean.

immediate_configure.description: Whether essential/important packages are configured immediately after unpacking.

force_loop_break.description: Whether essential packages may be removed to break conflict loops (NOT recommended).

cache_start.description: Size of the initial cache (in bytes, default ~20 MB).

cache_grow.description: Step size for growing the cache automatically (in bytes, default ~1 MB).

cache_limit.description: Maximum cache size (in bytes); 0 = no limit.

build_essential.description: List of packages treated as essential build dependencies.

never_auto_remove.description: List of regular expressions for packages that are never removed by apt autoremove.

protect_kernels.description: Whether kernel packages are protected from automatic removal.

versioned_kernel_packages.description: List of regular expressions identifying versioned kernel packages.

kernel_count.description: Number of kernels to keep on autoremove (at least 2).

pre_install_pkgs.description: Scripts run by dpkg before installation.

pre_install_recommends.description: Scripts for recommended packages (optional, rarely used).

acquire_retries.description: Number of download retries; 0 = no retry.

acquire_timeout.description: Time limit (in seconds) for a single download.

acquire_max_time.description: Maximum total time for all downloads (in seconds); 0 = no limit.

acquire_languages.description: Preferred languages for package translations (e.g. ['en', 'none'] for none).

acquire_check_valid_until.description: Whether the expiry date in Release files is checked (security feature).

acquire_check_date.description: Whether the system clock is trusted for security checks.

acquire_max_future_time.description: Maximum time (in seconds) a Release file may be dated before its creation date.

acquire_max_valid_time.description: Maximum validity period (in seconds) after creation; 0 = unlimited.

acquire_min_valid_time.description: Minimum time (in seconds) after creation before a file is valid.

periodic_update_pkg_lists.description: Interval (in days) for automatic apt-get update.

periodic_download_upgradeable.description: Interval (in days) for downloading upgradeable packages.

apt_get_show_upgraded.description: Whether upgraded packages are shown before installation.

apt_get_allow_remove.description: Whether removal of essential packages is allowed (caution!).
